component.name: Vagalume
component.summary: Control your graphics card's ARGB lighting

description.p: Vagalume controls the ARGB lighting on the ONIX Lumi B580 graphics card (board ID 8086:207e:a002), with seven effects, a color wheel, brightness and speed controls, and a tray icon. Other cards are not supported.
Vagalume is unofficial and not affiliated with ONIX or Intel.
It needs the kernel's i2c-dev module and permission to open the card's I2C device.
